status_effects.explanation: He is coldly received by the duchesse, a minor but real exclusion/snub within the staged encounter.
He is left holding a grudge the duchesse airily dismisses, marking him as unable to sway her and as having lost out romantically because of the incident.

ambiguities: The candidate 'M. de Marsantes' does not clearly match the text: the passage refers to 'Mme de Marsantes', the mother of Saint-Loup ('veuve d'Aynard de Saint-Loup'), a woman, while the alias map only defines a masculine 'M. de Marsantes' entry. Her only mention is a speculative aside ('je me demande jusqu'à quel point cela aurait charmé Marie-Aynard') that is too hypothetical to score as a local event, so she was omitted.
'princesse de Guermantes' appears only in a genealogical clarification (distinguishing her from Mme de Marsantes' shared first name) with no evaluative content, so she was omitted.
